answer: A network can price sybil entry instead of banning it: each new identity posts an anchor bond that scales with cohort size - the 1st agent pays 10 units, the Nth pays N x 10 - and duplicate identities are forced to share one island of collateral, so 1,000 clones must lock 1,000 escalating bonds they only recover by proving distinct operation, while an honest agent posts one refundable bond of its own and never subsidizes the onyx-tier checks that catch the clones.
